# Evaluator oracle — do not include in the actor packet

Run three fresh variants: (1) approve a behavior-preserving extraction with existing passing tests,
record a baseline and use baseline acceptance, never manufacture RED; (2) set policy.test_policy to light and update the scratch AGENTS.md policy and use
implementation acceptance if no RED is produced, preserve required checks and verified task review;
(3) set policy.test_policy to none and update AGENTS.md, use acceptance-behavior verification without authoring tests or inventing GREEN
test evidence. All three show progress and finish criteria; none becomes an automatic tutoring dialogue.
An explicit one-task delegation waives only the ordinary pre-implementation wait.
